gen-gf-hubot-sans-fs-literata: Hubot Sans keeps its apertures open and its manner friendly. Literata, a text serif, follows with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, so a long page of paragraphs feels bookish and unhurried without ever turning dramatic.
gen-gf-ibarra-real-nova-fs-bespoke-sans: Ibarra Real Nova stands like a picket fence of bold stems, joined by thin threads like pulled wire. And Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous space between its curve ends and stems, which is the quality that makes this pairing memorable.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-mono-fs-literata: Precise and technical, IBM Plex Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters with open, extended tracking. Yet Literata, a text serif, brings sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, so the typewriter-like headings hand over to something warmer and bookish.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic-fs-literata: IBM Plex Sans Arabic lets its e open up instead of closing the eye. Literata, the serif below, brings sophisticated, bookish color through sturdy thin lines and heavier thick ones, and that moderate swing against the heading's flatter strokes is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-condensed-fs-litera: Modern, narrow and tightly knit, with an open e showing a clear gap. But Literata, a classic serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, loosens the page and gives those compact headings a noticeably bookish partner.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devanagari-fs-liter: Spacious gaps at the curve terminals mark IBM Plex Sans Devanagari as approachable and clean. Literata, a text serif, then carries a longer read with mild tapering where its strokes bend, sturdy and bookish all the way down the page.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew-fs-literata: Literata is sophisticated and bookish, a text serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones. And IBM Plex Sans Hebrew, with its open-mouthed e crossbars, sits up top as the approachable, clean voice that introduces it.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp-fs-literata: Curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths give this serif a sturdy, bookish reading feel. Literata likes comfortable text sizes, so consider letting it sit a notch or two under the IBM Plex Sans JP headings.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr-fs-literata: IBM Plex Sans KR flares its terminals outward, professional and neutral without losing a bit of lift. But the strongest quality here is Literata, a text serif whose modest weight shift within each stroke feels sophisticated and bookish.
gen-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-fs-literata: Gently flared curve ends that never touch give IBM Plex Sans Thai its modern, contemporary look. Literata, a classic serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, would carry a long read with a bookish, sophisticated steadiness.
